terra.problem: The passage does not say Ezekiel was forbidden to speak until God gave him the explanation.
The passage does not say the wall belonged to Ezekiel or that it was made of drywall. The joke puts drywall dust into the Bible scene.
The passage does not identify the people watching Ezekiel as exiles. That fact needs a reference outside this passage.
The passage does not say how far Ezekiel is from Jerusalem, so the people there should not be described as far away.
Saying the prince not seeing Babylon fits his covered face suggests a connection the passage does not make.
The passage does not say Ezekiel eats in front of everybody or that the meal is lunch.
God tells Ezekiel to say the new message to the people. The passage does not say He tells the people to recite it instead.
The cookie-timer joke makes God's word part of the comparison, undercutting the required reverence for Scripture.
